title: Facet
description: A facet defines a detectable property that can be stamped onto Minecraft items.

description.description: Explanation of what this facet means and when it applies.

matches.description: The item satisfies at least one of these signals.

requires.description: Additional signals that must ALL be satisfied (AND with matches).

except_when.description: If any of these signals match, the facet is not assigned regardless of matches.

matchBlock.description: A set of signals. In the simple form, all listed signals are OR'd together within each key.

block_tags.description: Block tags for the placed form of the item.

path_words.description: Words that appear in the item's registry path when split on non-alphanumeric characters.

components.description: Data component IDs the item must have (e.g. minecraft:food).

creative_tab.description: Words that appear in the item's creative tab ID or label.

has_facet.description: Other facets that must already be assigned. Use path-style IDs (e.g. natural/seed).

any.description: Explicit OR — at least one child block must match.

all.description: Explicit AND — all child blocks must match.

not.description: Explicit NOT — the child block must not match.
